title: Illustrative placement and area allocation of Building B - the pure computation modules (scenario/three_answers/placement.py and area_allocation.py) with their unit tests (P-6.2 part A). Self-contained dataclasses mirroring rear_yard_checks.py; no wiring, no document change, no benchmark, no records.
objective: Add two pure, self-contained scenario-layer modules (mirror rear_yard_checks.py; frozen dataclasses, no I/O, no document assembly). (1) placement.py: build_placement(...) -> a building_placement dict conforming to contract 1.5.0 $defs.building_placement. It computes, from the settled step-P8 reading placement-building-b.json ONLY: the plate = zoning floor area per storey (20,150/3 = 6,716.67); the footprint on the printed-tax-map basis (depth 6716.6667/100.76 = 66.66; 100.76 x 66.66 = 6,716.66, reconciled to the plate within +/-0.5); for a placed placement, the footprint outline polygon (schema $defs.polygon) built from the computed depth/frontage/offsets with every vertex derived (never a typed value); the offsets each naming its basis (back clearance 33.34 derived-from-printed_tax_map vs 35.31 derived-from-gis; frontage touch 0 vs the 3.12 ft gis conflict); the method, basis (printed_tax_map, the stated A1 basis), measure const, conversion_statement const; the checks/conditions/not_checked arrays stated from the reference case (coverage lower bound, rear-yard band not known, street-wall/setback/side-area conditions, physical floor plate not checked). For the unplaced state it returns a withheld placement (status withheld, no outline). (2) area_allocation.py: build_area_allocation(...) -> an area_allocation dict conforming to $defs.area_allocation. It applies ONE stated share (0.60) to the residential floor area (20,150): apartment 12,090.00 total / 4,030.00 per storey; other 8,060.00 total / 2,686.67 per storey; total 20,150.00; apartment+other=total; fitted follows the placement status. Emitted for every alternative with a floor area, placed or not. Every number comes ONLY from placement-building-b.json and the arithmetic, never a program run; nothing is labelled complies/buildable/optimal/feasible; agreement of two AI readings is not proof. The modules MUST NOT import three_way_document.py, geometry.py, first_option_results.py, envelope_constraints.py or any report/drawing/route module; the outline is built as plain schema dicts.
business_reason: D-094 R044/R092 and the owner's 2026-10-14 review: the worked scenario (R143) needs a placement and an area allocation computed from source-based geometry on compatible measures. These two pure modules are the collision-free, dependency-free computation core; wiring them into the document, the benchmark, the register and the records is M5-T172b, which waits for M5-T169 and M5-T170 (shared engine/benchmark/register files). Building the core early is optional parallelism beside M5-T170 and produces no visible result on its own (supporting work).

acceptance_scenarios.given: Building B: 20,150 sq ft zoning floor area, 3 storeys, tax-map frontage 100.76 ft (placement-building-b.json rows plate, footprint-tax-map)
acceptance_scenarios.when: the plate and footprint are computed
acceptance_scenarios.then: plate = 6,716.67; depth = 6716.6667/100.76 = 66.66; footprint = 100.76 x 66.66 = 6,716.66 (derived from a printed_tax_map frontage); reconciles to the plate within +/-0.5 (0.01 apart), never forced into one figure

acceptance_scenarios.given: a placed placement with the stated A1 placement rule and the settled lot lines
acceptance_scenarios.then: a $defs.polygon outline with every vertex derived from the computed depth/frontage/offsets (R044, never a typed value); the outline area reconciles to the plate within +/-0.5; status placed carries outline, method, basis printed_tax_map, measure, conversion_statement

acceptance_scenarios.given: the unplaced state (benchmark; no threaded placement)
acceptance_scenarios.then: status withheld, carrying method/basis/measure/conversion_statement and NO outline (schema oneOf withheld branch; additionalProperties:false rejects an outline key)

acceptance_scenarios.given: share 0.60 on the residential floor area 20,150
acceptance_scenarios.then: apartment 12,090.00 total / 4,030.00 per storey; other 8,060.00 total / 2,686.67 per storey; total 20,150.00; apartment+other=total; the per-storey figures x3 equal the plate 6,716.67 (4,030.00+2,686.67=6,716.67)

acceptance_scenarios.given: the allocation other total 8,060.00 (0.40 x 20,150, derived) and the coverage lower bound 0.80 x 10,075 = 8,060 (administrative_record; the corner-lot by-portion rule, ref lot-coverage-max, makes 80% a conservative lower bound not the cap)
acceptance_scenarios.then: equal numerals but different quantities on different bases; a dedicated test asserts they are never summed, equated or carried as one figure (G-10)

each names its basis: back clearance 33.34 (derived from printed_tax_map) vs 35.31 (derived from gis) per placement-building-b.json gis-conflict-check [NOT 33.32 from the superseded work order]; frontage touch 0 vs the 3.12 ft gis frontage conflict; the two-basis difference is carried as a conflict, never silently resolved

acceptance_scenarios.given: the produced placement and area_allocation dicts
acceptance_scenarios.then: both conform to $defs.building_placement / $defs.area_allocation; additionalProperties:false rejects any unit count, room, wall, core, stair or elevator key (R093); label const 'Illustrative'; measure const 'residential_floor_area'; conversion_statement const the exact G-14 text; share within 0.60-0.75; a fitted:true with a withheld placement is refused by results_way_rules.py
the conversion_statement const is carried and 'physical floor plate (gross-up, exclusions, wall thickness)' is in not_checked; the plate is never called or returned as the physical floor plate

risks: RISK A1 (the split's safety hinge): the modules MUST be import-isolated from three_way_document.py/geometry.py/first_option_results.py/envelope_constraints.py (mirror rear_yard_checks.py, which imports only block_frontage), so M5-T170's concurrent geometry.py edits cannot touch them and __init__.py stays unedited. A G3 check confirms the import set.

RISK A2 (interface churn): the module signatures are designed before M5-T172b wires them; if Part B needs a different shape it must re-open these now-accepted files (a scope correction). Keep the signatures minimal and driven by the contract $defs. This risk is the main argument for building M5-T172 as one task instead.
RISK A3: expected values come ONLY from placement-building-b.json and the arithmetic; the G1 reviewer re-derives each against the case, never a program run.
RISK A4: the GIS south offset is 35.31 (not the stale 33.32); G1 confirms against the reference case before the value is pinned.
